test.create_query: CREATE TABLE primary_key_filter_elimination ( tenant UInt32, ts UInt64, status UInt8, amount UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (tenant, ts) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, index_granularity_bytes = 0, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, add_minmax_index_for_numeric_columns = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO primary_key_filter_elimination SELECT intDiv(number, 4194304), (number % 4194304) * 1024 + cityHash64(number) % 1024, number % 8, cityHash64(number, 1) % 10000 FROM numbers(8388608) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
